title: Filou Oostende claim Euromillions League title
description: Belfius Mons - Oostende 62-69 Oostende are Euromillions League 20/21 champions. They beat Belfius Mons on the road in Game 4 to capture the trophy. The guests took control from the first minutes by winning the initial quarter 18-14. But Belfius Mons-Hainaut won second period 19-16. However it was not enough to take a lead and get a victory that evening. The former international swingman Loic Schwartz (197-92) fired 20 points and 5 rebounds for the winners. Serbian guard Dusan Djordjevic (193-83, agency: BeoBasket) chipped in 14 points and 5 assists. Oostende's coach Dario Gjergja used a ten-player rotation which allowed the starters a little rest for the next games. American power forward Skylar Spencer (206-94, college: SDSU) produced a double-double by scoring 11 points and 11 rebounds and his fellow American import guard Jabril Durham (185-94, college: Arkansas) added 14 points…
